name: Croatia Control
notes: crocontrol.hr (page title 'Crocontrol - Hrvatska kontrola zračne plovidbe', copyright 'Croatia Control') has a Graphic Materials page under Media ('Here you can find our logos') offering a JPG preview plus EPS and AI zip packages. Stored: the JPG and the EPS from the zip on that page (tier 1; the EPS source_url is the zip), plus the square icon from the site header (tier 2, website-served). The EPS was rendered in scratch with Ghostscript and confirmed as the Croatia Control logo; its transparency is recorded as false (not determined by the validator). The AI zip package was not stored (AI is not an accepted format). No usage terms stated on the page, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.

gaps.need: dark variant, transparent logo and SVG
gaps.reason: Graphic Materials page offers an opaque JPG, an EPS (colour) and an AI package; no white or transparent version published
